name: Tella
description:
Tella is the easiest way to record and share great-looking videos - screen recordings, demos, tutorials, and talking-head videos.

This connector brings your entire Tella library into Claude, so you can edit and manage videos in plain language.

Ask Claude to trim a clip, cut a section by quoting the transcript, remove silences and filler words, or tighten a 10-minute recording into a 2-minute cut.

Claude can apply Tella's signature polish for you: automatic zooms, camera and screen layouts, backgrounds, blurs, highlights, overlays, and background music.

Key features:

- Edit by transcript: say "cut the part where I talk about pricing" and Claude finds and removes it
- Clean up recordings: remove silences, filler words, and mistakes in one request
- Auto-polish: generate zooms and layouts, add music, sound effects, and overlays
- Organize your library: search videos, manage playlists, tags, chapters, and thumbnails
- Share and ship: set thumbnails, add collaborators, and export finished videos without leaving Claude

Perfect for founders, educators, and teams who record often and want editing to take minutes, not hours.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tella to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tella to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.tella.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tella MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tella lists 86 MCP tools, including add_blur, add_collaborator_to_video, add_highlight, add_layout, add_overlay, add_sound_effect, add_video_tag, add_video_to_playlist, add_zoom, auto_crop, create_playlist, and create_playlist_group.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tella?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tella in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Tella requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tella is developed by Tella. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
